title: Comfort Club Billing Note: Adding a System During the Term
content:
Billing office note on enrolling another system under an existing Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements agreement in the middle of a term.

- **Status.** A system is added only while the agreement status is active.
- **Eligibility.** The added system must meet the enrollment eligibility rules on the date it is added, and the new number of systems covered may not exceed the tier's maximum number of systems.
- **Annual agreements.** The additional system dues charge is the tier's additional-system annual rate multiplied by the unused full months from the date added to the term end, divided by twelve and rounded to the cent half up. No charge is posted when no full month remains.
- **Monthly agreements.** The tier's monthly additional-system rate is added to the dues from the next billing month, and nothing is charged for the current month.
- **Visits.** The added system receives its visits under the maintenance visit rules.
- **Removing systems.** Systems are removed only at renewal, never mid-term, and removing a system earns no credit.

**Unused full months** are the whole calendar months remaining, counted as complete month-to-month steps from the date added that end on or before the term end; a partial month counts as zero.

### Worked example (hypothetical annual Comfort Club Gold agreement)
A system added on 15 August 2025, term ending 31 January 2026. Steps ending 15 September, 15 October, 15 November, 15 December and 15 January fall on or before 31 January; the step to 15 February does not, so 5 unused full months remain. The charge is the additional-system annual rate of 169.00 multiplied by 5 and divided by twelve: 70.4166..., rounded half up to 70.42 USD.

### Same addition on monthly billing
The 14.95 monthly additional-system rate joins the dues from the September billing month; August carries no charge for the added system.

### Points of judgement
- Added on 5 January with the term ending 31 January: no full month remains, so no charge posts.
- A Comfort Club Basic agreement already covering 2 systems cannot add a third.
